# TASK-022 Report-ready email

Status: blocked

Outcome: when a report finishes, the shop's customers get a "your report is ready" email, as the ruling cited below allows.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent. Confirm it before relying on it.

Reference
  Binding        mira
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0003
  Path           docs/adr/0003-no-new-kind-of-customer-message-without-approval.md
  Commit         39f397435a078f1a86db014e9eae952a96e0e20e
  Digest         sha256:c2c20d6ed7807f7b667324a8e336a2a48502985548d0b79c514d1e742c000000

## Agent check (2026-10-21)

Decision: stop; the email was not built.

- Digest mismatch: the task cites sha256:c2c20d6ed7807f7b667324a8e336a2a48502985548d0b79c514d1e742c000000 for ADR 0003 at commit 39f397435a078f1a86db014e9eae952a96e0e20e. The file at that commit hashes to sha256:c2c20d6ed7807f7b667324a8e336a2a48502985548d0b79c514d1e742c7f3f11. The text the sender saw is not the text in the log, so the reference is unverified.
- The ruling (status Accepted, not superseded) does not allow this email. It says no new kind of customer message goes out until Mira has approved that kind in the decision log (key: customer-outreach). No approval for a report-ready email is recorded in mira-decisions (ADRs 0001-0004).
- To unblock: Mira records an approval for the report-ready email (wording included) in mira-decisions, and the planning agent re-issues the reference with the correct digest.
